comparison.objective: Lift a rabbit surrogate into a carrier while continuously supporting its back.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated two-point support and level transport of an articulated load.
comparison.success_condition: Rabbit deposited in carrier; spine bend over 25 degrees or a fall of at least 3 cm irreversibly scores zero.
comparison.reason: Tests distributed support of an articulated body rather than tool-on-feature alignment, fracture control, and small-part recovery.
